{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&DIntensityVolatility", "construction": "standard deviation of R&D expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D investments may have more uncertain futures, leading to higher required returns. This volatility can capture the risk of innovation and exploration.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "CustomerConcentration", "construction": "Herfindahl index of customer sales concentration, calculated as the sum of squared percentages of sales to each customer, over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated customer bases may face higher default risk and lower bargaining power, increasing their cost of capital. This concentration can capture the risk of customer dependence.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "InventoryTurnoverAccelerations", "construction": "average change in inventory turnover over the past 2 years, calculated as the year-over-year difference in cost of goods sold divided by average inventory", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating inventory turnover may be experiencing improving operational efficiency or increasing demand, leading to higher expected returns. This acceleration can capture the benefits of logistics and supply chain management.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": " PatentCitationLag", "construction": "average time lag between patent application and citation, calculated over the past 10 years", "rationale": "Firms with shorter patent citation lags may have more impactful and timely innovations, leading to higher expected returns. This lag can capture the speed and relevance of innovation.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "DirectorBusyness", "construction": "average number of external board seats held by each director, calculated over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with busier directors may have less effective governance and monitoring, leading to higher agency costs and lower expected returns. This busyness can capture the risk of director distraction and lack of attention.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "EarningsCallTone", "construction": "textual analysis of earnings call transcripts, quantifying the tone and sentiment of management's language, over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with more optimistic and confident management tone may have higher expected growth and returns, while those with pessimistic tone may have lower expected returns. This tone can capture the soft information and managerial expectations.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "SalesGrowthDeceleration", "construction": "average change in sales growth rate over the past 3 years, calculated as the year-over-year difference in sales growth", "rationale": "Firms with decelerating sales growth may be experiencing declining demand or increasing competition, leading to lower expected returns. This deceleration can capture the risks of market saturation and competitive pressure.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "EmployeeGrowthVolatility", "construction": "standard deviation of employee growth rate over the past 5 years, calculated as the year-over-year difference in total employees", "rationale": "Firms with volatile employee growth may have higher labor costs and lower operational efficiency, leading to lower expected returns. This volatility can capture the risks of hiring and firing, and the challenges of managing a growing workforce.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "SupplierIndustryConcentration", "construction": "Herfindahl index of supplier industry concentration, calculated as the sum of squared percentages of sales to each supplier industry, over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated supplier industries may face higher input costs and lower bargaining power, increasing their cost of capital. This concentration can capture the risk of supplier dependence and input price volatility.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "GeographicSegmentation", "construction": "number of geographic segments reported by the firm, calculated over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with more geographic segments may have more complex operations and higher agency costs, leading to lower expected returns. This segmentation can capture the challenges of managing multiple locations and diverse customer bases.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
